# SmartCiti.X learner platform — llms.txt

> Demo mode — sample data, not real learners.
> Simulation only — NOT certification, licensure, or clinical training.
> SmartCiti.X is proposed, not incorporated / funded / offered.

## Start here

- Learner VR Entry: vr-entry/index.html (mode picker, guided first path,
  skill graph, Holodeck Coach, Holodeck entry)
- Training scenarios viewer: scenarios/index.html (6 scenarios, works from file://)
- Scenario index: scenarios/scenarios.json
- Cohort Dashboard v2 (demo): dashboard-v2-demo.html (sample data, filters)
- LearnerProgressEvent contract: learner-progress-contract.json (Phase 1)
- Sample log: sample-log.json (20 anonymised events, 5 learners)
- Agent catalog: ai-catalog.json
- Agent skills: .well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Access: auth.md (human-gated; no accounts, no OAuth, no tokens)
- Resources linkset: .well-known/api-catalog (real files only — no API exists)

## Scenarios (6)

- k12-arvr-foundations — K-12 AR/VR foundations: measure, tools, safety
- union-trades-electrical — Union trades, electrical: panel & conduit install
- union-trades-hvac — Union trades, HVAC: diagnose, braze & commission
- robotics-integration — Robotics: human-robot integration in a shared cell
- safety-procedures — Safety procedures: hazards, PPE, fit, report
- dental-screening-outreach — Outreach: prevention & school screening

Deep link: scenarios/index.html?scenario=<scenarioId>
TradePath deep links (e.g. /?zone=hvac) open the matching IWSDK zone.

## Skill graph

11 registry strands (verbatim from pack/registry/skills.json via vr-entry
README): coordination, documentation, inspection, layout, leadership,
machines, materials, procedure, safety, tools, troubleshooting.
ZPD band 0.70–0.85; gate 0.95 + 3 unaided successes. Mastery on the entry
page uses the dashboard demo rule (passed, mastery ≥ 0.60) and is labelled
as such; the real gate is shown separately.

## State

No HTTP API exists. Progress is a local sample log + in-page computation
(dashboard demo, VR entry) and in-memory checklist state (scenario viewer).
No live data feed. Real mode needs a validated log owner and anonymisation
rules. VR station → skill mapping (Phase 4) is open — real station IDs are
needed before a Holodeck station completion can move a skill on the graph.

## Grounding

- OSHA PPE topic page (osha.gov/personal-protective-equipment)
- EPA Section 608 (epa.gov/section608; 40 CFR Part 82 Subpart F)
- CDC Guidelines for Infection Control in Dental Health-Care Settings 2003
  (MMWR 52(RR17)), via the UnspokenSmiled-VR wiki research notes
- SmartCiti.X wiki (~/workspace/your_files/org-wikis/SmartCiti.X/WIKI.md):
  111-hall roster is an in-repo list, 0 of 111 signed off; 11 simulators;
  10 authored campuses (not physical); "nothing here certifies anybody"

## Limits

- Louisiana + Indiana training sites are proposed/planned; no site, city,
  or address has been named.
- Never present a named hall as a partner; never quote "66-W3 series"
  (correct: 33 named W3 sub-series, April 2026 internal list; SmartCiti.X
  is S10 of those 33).
- No real Quest / headset / phone run has been done in this environment.
